name: Switch (Combat)
body:
You can utilize one of your hair switches as a whip.

Prerequisite: Seedling, base attack bonus +1.

Benefit: Once per day, you can cut off a single hair switch to use as a whip. You are proficient with your switch even if you are not proficient with normal whips.
